title: FLUID: Flexible, Evidence-Grounded Situated Task Guidance
title_zh: FLUID：灵活且基于证据的情境化任务指导
abstract_en: Real-time task guidance is inherently flexible: when an agent guides a user through a task, multiple responses and timings can be appropriate, and sometimes the best action is to remain silent. Existing benchmarks often miss this flexibility by treating synthesized dialogues as fixed targets for what to say and when to say it. We introduce FLUID (Flexible, Evidence-Grounded Situated Task Guidance), a unified framework for modeling, evaluating, and enabling flexible interaction in multimodal task guidance. Using naturally occurring human-human guidance from WTaG and HoloAssist, FLUID grounds interventions in their supporting evidence, necessity, and timing flexibility, and uses this representation both to evaluate flexible guidance and to build a real-time agent for task guidance. Our agent achieves the strongest overall balance of response correctness, intervention precision, timely guidance, and response latency among evaluated systems, while still leaving room for improvement in avoiding speech overlap. Together, FLUID moves situated task guidance beyond rigid reference matching toward more natural and adaptive human-AI interaction. Project page: https://fluid-guidance.github.io.
abstract_zh: 实时任务指导并没有唯一正确的说法或时机，有时保持沉默才是最佳选择。现有基准常把合成对话当作固定参考，因而难以评估这种灵活性。FLUID 是一个用于建模、评估和实现灵活多模态任务指导的统一框架。它利用 WTaG 和 HoloAssist 中自然发生的人际指导交互，从支持证据、介入必要性和时机灵活性三个维度表征指导行为，并以此评估灵活指导、构建实时指导智能体。在受评系统中，该智能体在回答正确性、介入精确性、指导及时性和响应延迟之间取得了最佳的整体平衡，但在避免与用户同时说话方面仍有改进空间。
key_points_zh: 同一任务情境下，多种指导内容和介入时机都可能合理，固定参考对话难以衡量这种灵活性。
FLUID 利用 WTaG 和 HoloAssist 的自然人际指导数据，表征每次介入的支持证据、必要性和时机灵活性。
同一套表征既用于评估灵活指导，也用于构建实时多模态指导智能体。
该智能体在受评系统中取得最佳整体表现平衡，但仍需减少与用户同时说话的情况。
